title: Act: Add zustand and create useUiStore with drawer and modal state
summary: Create store file with drawer and modal state and actions.
description: Add zustand to package.json dependencies and create src/store/uiStore.ts exporting useUiStore with drawerOpen, activeModal and their actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the file, When imported, Then useUiStore is exported
Given toggleDrawer, When called, Then drawerOpen flips

steps.action: Add the dependency "zustand": "^4.5.0" to the dependencies object, then run npm install in game/frontend.

Create the file exporting type UiModal = 'contribution' | 'settings', interface UiState and useUiStore with drawerOpen=false, activeModal=null, toggleDrawer, setDrawerOpen(open), openModal(modal), closeModal().
